question: 62 + 71 − 49 + 34 × 2 − (33 + 14) = ?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 105.

GIVEN

• 62 + 71 − 49 + 34 × 2 − (33 + 14)

SOLUTION

• Brackets: (33 + 14) = 47.

• Multiply: 34 × 2 = 68.

• 62 + 71 − 49 + 68 − 47 = 133 − 49 + 68 − 47 = 84 + 68 − 47 = 152 − 47 = 105.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Group additions and subtractions: (62+71+68) − (49+47) = 201 − 96 = 105.

NOTE

• Always apply BODMAS — Brackets, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction — in that order.

question: 93 − 46 + 72 − (25 + 18) + 33 × 2 = ?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 142.

GIVEN

• 93 − 46 + 72 − (25 + 18) + 33 × 2

SOLUTION

• Brackets: (25 + 18) = 43.

• Multiply: 33 × 2 = 66.

• 93 − 46 + 72 − 43 + 66 = 47 + 72 − 43 + 66 = 119 − 43 + 66 = 76 + 66 = 142.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Positives (93+72+66) = 231; negatives (46+43) = 89; 231 − 89 = 142.

NOTE

• Resolve brackets and multiplication before left-to-right addition/subtraction (BODMAS).

question: 83 + (19 × 2) − 44 + 37 ÷ 1 + 26 − 21 = ?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 119.

GIVEN

• 83 + (19 × 2) − 44 + 37 ÷ 1 + 26 − 21

SOLUTION

• Bracket/multiply: 19 × 2 = 38.

• Divide: 37 ÷ 1 = 37.

• 83 + 38 − 44 + 37 + 26 − 21 = 121 − 44 + 37 + 26 − 21 = 77 + 37 + 26 − 21 = 140 − 21 = 119.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Positives (83+38+37+26) = 184; negatives (44+21) = 65; 184 − 65 = 119.

NOTE

• Any number divided by 1 stays the same; simplify such terms first to save time.

question: A 120-litre solution of salt and water contains 25% salt. If 30 litres of water are added, what is the new percentage of salt in the solution?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 20%.

GIVEN

• 120 L solution with 25% salt; 30 L water added.

SOLUTION

• Salt = 25% of 120 = 30 L (salt quantity is unchanged).

• New total = 120 + 30 = 150 L.

• New % of salt = 30 ÷ 150 × 100 = 20%.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Salt is fixed; % scales inversely with volume: 25% × (120/150) = 20%.

NOTE

• When only the solvent (water) is added, the solute amount stays constant — track it, not the percentage.

question: A man sells 36 bags for Rs 3600, which results in a 20% loss. How many bags must he sell for Rs 3200 to make a 60% profit?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 16.

GIVEN

• 36 bags sold for Rs 3600 at 20% loss; find bags to sell for Rs 3200 at 60% profit.

SOLUTION

• CP of 36 bags = 3600 ÷ 0.80 = Rs 4500, so CP per bag = 4500 ÷ 36 = Rs 125.

• Required SP per bag at 60% profit = 125 × 1.60 = Rs 200.

• Bags for Rs 3200 = 3200 ÷ 200 = 16.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Per-bag SP at 20% loss = 3600/36 = 100 = 80% of CP ⇒ CP = 125; new SP = 160% × 125 = 200 ⇒ 3200/200 = 16.

NOTE

• SP = CP × (100 ± profit/loss %)/100; solve for CP first when loss/profit % is given.

question: The ratio of the income to the expenditure of a town is 7:6. If the income is ₹3500, what is the saving?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. ₹500.

GIVEN

• Income : Expenditure = 7 : 6; Income = ₹3500.

SOLUTION

• 7 parts = ₹3500, so 1 part = ₹500.

• Expenditure = 6 × 500 = ₹3000.

• Saving = Income − Expenditure = 3500 − 3000 = ₹500.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Saving corresponds to (7 − 6) = 1 part = 3500/7 = ₹500 directly.

NOTE

• Saving = Income − Expenditure; in ratio problems the saving's ratio part = difference of the ratio numbers.

question: In an election between two candidates, one got 55% of the total valid votes. If 20% of the votes were invalid and the total number of votes was 9,000, what was the number of valid votes the other candidate got?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 3240.

GIVEN

• Total votes = 9000; 20% invalid; one candidate got 55% of valid votes.

SOLUTION

• Valid votes = 80% of 9000 = 7200.

• Other candidate got 100% − 55% = 45% of valid votes.

• 45% of 7200 = 0.45 × 7200 = 3240.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Directly: 9000 × 80% × 45% = 9000 × 0.36 = 3240.

NOTE

• With two candidates, their valid-vote shares add to 100%; work on valid votes only, not the total.

question: A and B start a business with capitals of Rs. 20,000 and Rs. 45,000. If the profit is divided in the ratio 2 : 3, determine the ratio of the time periods of investment for A and B.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 3 : 2.

GIVEN

• Capitals A : B = 20000 : 45000; Profit A : B = 2 : 3.

SOLUTION

• Profit ∝ Capital × Time ⇒ Time ∝ Profit ÷ Capital.

• Time A : Time B = (2/20000) : (3/45000) = (2/20000) : (1/15000).

• Multiply both by 60000: = 6 : 4 = 3 : 2.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Time ratio = (Profit ratio) ÷ (Capital ratio) = (2:3) ÷ (4:9) = (2/4):(3/9) = 1/2 : 1/3 = 3 : 2.

NOTE

• In partnership, Profit = Capital × Time; if profit and capital ratios are known, Time ratio = Profit ratio ÷ Capital ratio.

question: Find the least number that must be added to 5600 to make it a perfect square.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 25.

GIVEN

• Least number to be added to 5600 to make it a perfect square.

SOLUTION

• √5600 ≈ 74.83, so the next whole number is 75.

• 75² = 5625.

• Number to add = 5625 − 5600 = 25.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Find the nearest higher square: 74² = 5476 (too low), 75² = 5625 ⇒ add 5625 − 5600 = 25.

NOTE

• To reach the next perfect square, take the ceiling of the square root, square it, then subtract the given number.

question: A square park has an area equal to the area of a rectangle whose length exceeds its breadth by 9 m and the breadth is half the side of the square. Find the side of the square.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 6 m.

GIVEN

• Square area = rectangle area; rectangle length = breadth + 9; breadth = ½ × side of square.

SOLUTION

• Let side = s, so breadth = s/2 and length = s/2 + 9.

• s² = (s/2)(s/2 + 9) = s²/4 + 9s/2.

• s² − s²/4 = 9s/2 ⇒ (3/4)s² = 9s/2 ⇒ (3/4)s = 9/2 ⇒ s = 6 m.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• With b = s/2, area equality gives s² = b(b+9) ⇒ (2b)² = b(b+9) ⇒ 4b = b+9 ⇒ b = 3 ⇒ s = 6 m.

NOTE

• Area of square = side²; area of rectangle = length × breadth. Set up one variable using the given relations.

question: The population increases by 13% annually. If the current population is 43,000, what will it be after 3 years? (in approx.)
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 62,047.

GIVEN

• Present population = 43,000; growth = 13% per year; time = 3 years.

SOLUTION

• Population = 43000 × (1.13)³.

• (1.13)³ = 1.442897.

• 43000 × 1.442897 ≈ 62,045 ≈ 62,047 (approx).

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Apply compound growth: 43000 → 48590 → 54907 → 62045, matching ≈ 62,047.

NOTE

• Population after n years = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ — the compound interest formula applied to growth.

question: Which of the following lies between & ?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 18/11.

GIVEN

• A value lying between 1 3/5 and 2 1/5.

SOLUTION

• 1 3/5 = 1.6 and 2 1/5 = 2.2, so the value must be between 1.6 and 2.2.

• 18/11 = 1.636 ✓ (in range); 14/9 = 1.555 ✗; 9/4 = 2.25 ✗; 14/6 = 2.333 ✗.

• Only 18/11 lies between them = 18/11.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Convert everything to decimals and check which option falls in (1.6, 2.2) — only 18/11 = 1.636 qualifies.

NOTE

• Convert mixed numbers to decimals/improper fractions for quick comparison of ranges.

question: 0.0007 + 0.07 + 0.007 + 0.7 = ?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 0.7777.

GIVEN

• 0.0007 + 0.07 + 0.007 + 0.7

SOLUTION

• Align decimals: 0.7000 + 0.0700 + 0.0070 + 0.0007.

• Add place by place: tenths 7, hundredths 7, thousandths 7, ten-thousandths 7.

• Sum = 0.7777.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Each term supplies a single 7 in a different decimal place ⇒ result is 0.7777.

NOTE

• When adding decimals, line up the decimal points and pad with zeros to equal lengths.

question: The product of two consecutive even numbers is 624. What is the sum of the two numbers?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 50.

GIVEN

• Two consecutive even numbers with product 624.

SOLUTION

• √624 ≈ 24.98, so the numbers straddle 25: try 24 and 26.

• 24 × 26 = 624 ✓.

• Sum = 24 + 26 = 50.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• For n(n+2) = 624, take √624 ≈ 25 ⇒ numbers are 24 and 26 ⇒ sum = 50.

NOTE

• For a product of two close numbers, the square root sits between them — a fast way to locate the pair.

question: The difference of squares of two consecutive odd numbers is 24. What is the sum of the two numbers?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 12.

GIVEN

• Two consecutive odd numbers whose squares differ by 24.

SOLUTION

• Let them be n and n + 2: (n+2)² − n² = 4n + 4 = 24.

• 4n = 20 ⇒ n = 5, so numbers are 5 and 7.

• Sum = 5 + 7 = 12.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• a² − b² = (a+b)(a−b); here a − b = 2, so (a+b) × 2 = 24 ⇒ sum = 12 directly.

NOTE

• Use a² − b² = (a+b)(a−b); the difference of consecutive odd (or even) numbers is always 2.

question: Which of the following number is NOT divisible by 11?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 1235.

GIVEN

• Identify the number not divisible by 11.

SOLUTION

• Rule: (sum of odd-place digits) − (sum of even-place digits) must be 0 or a multiple of 11.

• 1235 → (5+2) − (3+1) = 3 ✗ not divisible.

• 4862 → 0, 1254 → 0, 1639 → 11, all divisible; so the odd one is 1235.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Take the alternating digit sum; if it is not a multiple of 11, the number is not divisible — 1235 gives 3.

NOTE

• Divisibility by 11: alternate + and − on digits from the right; the result should be 0 or ±11, ±22, …

question: 28P3 is divisible by 11. What is the value of P?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 9.

GIVEN

• Four-digit number 28P3 is divisible by 11.

SOLUTION

• Alternating sum (from right): 3 − P + 8 − 2 = 9 − P.

• For divisibility by 11, 9 − P must be 0 or a multiple of 11 ⇒ 9 − P = 0.

• P = 9.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Set (odd-place sum) − (even-place sum) = 0: (3+8) − (P+2) = 9 − P = 0 ⇒ P = 9.

NOTE

• For a missing digit and divisibility by 11, equate the alternating digit sum to 0 (or ±11) and solve.

question: Average of first ‘N’ odd natural numbers is 27. What is the value of ‘N’?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 27.

GIVEN

• Average of the first N odd natural numbers = 27.

SOLUTION

• Sum of first N odd numbers = N².

• Average = N² ÷ N = N.

• So N = 27.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• The average of the first N odd numbers always equals N, so the answer is simply 27.

NOTE

• 1 + 3 + 5 + … + (2N−1) = N², hence their average is N.

question: The average of 8 consecutive odd natural numbers is 24. Which is the smallest number out of these 8 numbers?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 17.

GIVEN

• 8 consecutive odd natural numbers with average 24.

SOLUTION

• For an even count, average lies midway between the 4th and 5th terms, both differing from the mean by 1 and 1.

• Numbers: 17, 19, 21, 23, 25, 27, 29, 31; check (17 + 31)/2 = 24 ✓.

• Smallest = 17.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• With 8 terms of common difference 2, spread is 7×2 = 14; smallest = 24 − 7 = 17.

NOTE

• For k consecutive terms, average = (first + last)/2; smallest = average − (k−1)×d/2.

question: The average of three values is 50. First value is 1/2 of the third value. Third value is 30 more than second value. What is the first value?
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option i.e. 36.

GIVEN

• Average of three values = 50; first = ½ × third; third = second + 30.

SOLUTION

• Let third = c, first = c/2, second = c − 30. Sum = 3 × 50 = 150.

• c/2 + (c − 30) + c = 150 ⇒ (5c/2) − 30 = 150 ⇒ 5c/2 = 180 ⇒ c = 72.

• First = c/2 = 72/2 = 36.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option.

SHORT TRICK

• Express all in terms of third value c, sum to 150: 2.5c = 180 ⇒ c = 72 ⇒ first = 36.

NOTE

• Sum of values = average × count; set up one variable using the given relations, then solve.
